name: MATH 1060Q
title: Precalculus
description: Preparation for calculus. Review of algebra. Functions and their applications; in particular, polynomials, rational functions, exponentials, logarithms and trigonometric functions.
requirement_description: A qualifying score on the math placement assessment (placement.uconn.edu/mathematics-placement). May not be taken out of sequence after passing MATH 1120,1125, or 1131. Not open for credit after passing MATH 1040.
